blood_rain.blood_drinker_description: Heals for [blue]{BloodRainRules.HealPercent}%[/blue] of the unblocked damage it deals.
devas.chakra_description: At the start of each combat, this card gains [gold]{@devas.karma}[/gold] equal to its [gold]{@devas.chakra}[/gold].
devas.devas_blessing_description: The first time it would die, it lives on until it has acted once more, then dies. Hits still land, but can't kill it.
devas.karma_description: Each [gold]{@devas.karma}[/gold] lowers this card's cost by [blue]1[/blue], and playing it uses up only the [gold]{@devas.karma}[/gold] it needed. Negative [gold]{@devas.karma}[/gold] raises the cost instead. Lasts until the end of combat.

devas.karma_zero_cost_note: This card costs [blue]0[/blue]: playing it gives [blue]1[/blue] of its [gold]{@devas.karma}[/gold] to a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] instead.
devas.samsara_description: Cards you play lose [blue]{KarmaRules.SamsaraKarmaLossPerPlay}[/blue] [gold]{@devas.karma}[/gold], and it can go negative. At the end of your turn, cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] with negative [gold]{@devas.karma}[/gold] gain [blue]1[/blue] back.
effect.blinding_hallowed.fights: {Zone}: you have [gold]{@hallowed.blasphemer}[/gold] and enemies are [gold]{@hallowed.zealous}[/gold]. In card rewards, attacks have [gold]{@hallowed.hallowing}[/gold] and other cards [gold]{@hallowed.redemption}[/gold].
effect.blinding_hallowed.repent: {Zone}: you can [gold]Repent[/gold]: lose [red]{HallowedRules.RepentHpCost}[/red] HP to remove all [red]Curses[/red] and give [blue]{HallowedRules.RepentAttackCount}[/blue] random attacks [gold]{@hallowed.hallowing}[/gold].
effect.blood_rain.blood_drinkers: {Zone}: enemies have [gold]{@blood_rain.blood_drinker}[/gold]. Winning a fight gives [green]{BloodRainRules.NormalMaxHpReward}[/green] Max HP ([green]{BloodRainRules.EliteMaxHpReward}[/green] after elites).
effect.blood_rain.blood_sacrifice: {Zone}: you can make a [gold]Blood Sacrifice[/gold]: lose [red]{BloodRainRules.SacrificeMaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP to heal to full and upgrade a card.

effect.devas_domain.fights: {Zone}: you have [gold]{@devas.samsara}[/gold] and enemies have [gold]{@devas.devas_blessing}[/gold]. [blue]1[/blue] Attack or Skill in each card reward has [gold]{@devas.chakra}[/gold].
effect.devas_domain.meditate: {Zone}: you can [gold]Meditate[/gold]: heal [green]{KarmaRules.MeditateHealPercent}%[/green] and give an Attack or Skill [gold]{@devas.chakra}[/gold] [blue]{KarmaRules.MeditateChakra}[/blue], or double its [gold]{@devas.chakra}[/gold].

effect.fermentory.distil: {Zone}: you can [gold]{@fermentory.distil}[/gold]: gain a potion and [blue]{FermentoryRules.DistilGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], and a potion slot becomes a [gold]{@fermentory.special_slot}[/gold].
effect.fermentory.fights: {Zone}: enemies take turns [gold]{@fermentory.brewing}[/gold]. Winning also gives a potion slot, a potion or a [gold]{@fermentory.special_slot}[/gold].
effect.fermentory.shop: {Zone}: [blue]{FermentoryRules.ShopPotionCount}[/blue] potions for sale. A [gold]{@fermentory.bottle}[/gold] replaces card removal.
effect.ferrosand.magnetic_foes: {Zone}: enemies are [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetized}[/gold] and have [gold]{@ferrosand.ferroform}[/gold]. Card rewards are [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold], and fights also make [blue]1[/blue] random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold].
effect.forgotten_empire.marbled_shop: {Zone}: cards for sale that gain [gold]Block[/gold] are [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbled}[/gold].
effect.forgotten_empire.sculpt: {Zone}: you can [gold]Sculpt[/gold]: make a Block card [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbled}[/gold].
effect.forgotten_empire.statues: {Zone}: every enemy is a [gold]{@forgotten_empire.forgotten_statue}[/gold]. Card rewards are [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbled}[/gold] or have [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbling}[/gold].
effect.halls_of_midas.gilded_shop: {Zone}: every card for sale is [green]upgraded[/green] but costs [blue]{HallsOfMidasRules.ShopMarkupPercent}%[/blue] more.
effect.halls_of_midas.luxurious_rest: {Zone}: [gold]Rest[/gold] becomes [gold]Luxurious Rest[/gold]: it heals [green]twice as much[/green] but costs [gold]{HallsOfMidasRules.LuxuriousRestGoldCost} Gold[/gold].
effect.hoarfrost.frostbind: {Zone}: you can [gold]Frostbind[/gold]: give a card [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold] [blue]{FrostRules.FrostbindColdPerCost}[/blue] per energy it costs.

effect.infestation.wrigglers: {Zone}: fights start with [blue]2[/blue] [red]Infection[/red] in your [gold]Hand[/gold], and enemies that aren't minions release a [red]Wriggler[/red] when they die. Card rewards have [gold]{@infestation.wriggling}[/gold].

effect.phantasmal_tombs.phantasms: {Zone}: enemies have [gold]{@phantasmal.phantasm}[/gold]. [blue]1[/blue] card in each card reward is [gold]{@phantasmal.phantasm_haunted}[/gold], and rewards may include a [gold]Ghost in a Jar[/gold].
effect.phantasmal_tombs.raided_shop: {Zone}: ghosts raided the merchant: about half the stock is gone, the rest is [blue]{PhantasmalRules.ShopDiscountPercent}%[/blue] off, and its cards are [gold]{@phantasmal.phantasm_haunted}[/gold].
effect.prismatic_storm.stare_at_prism: {Zone}: you can [gold]Stare at Prism[/gold] for a [gold]card reward[/gold] of [green]upgraded[/green] colourless cards.
effect.prismatic_storm.storm_buffs: {Zone}: enemies start with a random [gold]buff[/gold], and fights give [blue]2[/blue] extra [gold]card rewards[/gold] from any character.
effect.prismatic_storm.transform_service: {Zone}: the merchant offers [gold]Transform[/gold] instead of card removal.
effect.scrapyard.rummage: {Zone}: you can [gold]Rummage[/gold] through the scrap for [green]random loot[/green].
effect.scrapyard.scrap_bots: {Zone}: fights add [blue]1-2[/blue] [red]scrap bots[/red], and afterwards you can [gold]trash a card[/gold].
effect.scrapyard.scrap_service: {Zone}: the merchant offers [gold]Scrap[/gold] instead of card removal.
effect.shadow_corruption.fights: {Zone}: intents are hidden and enemies have [gold]{@shadow.shadow_brutality}[/gold]. Each turn, a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] is [gold]{@shadow.shaded}[/gold]. [blue]{ShadowRules.LightTheWayCopies}[/blue] [gold]{@shadow.light_the_way}[/gold] join your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Card rewards have [blue]1[/blue] [gold]{@shadow.shadow_corrupted}[/gold] card.

effect.shadow_corruption.troubled_dreams: {Zone}: [gold]Rest[/gold] becomes [gold]Troubled Dreams[/gold]: it doesn't use up your action, but has a [blue]{ShadowRules.TroubledDreamsCursePercent}%[/blue] chance to add a [red]Curse[/red]. No [gold]Mend[/gold].
effect.zone.chest_relic: {Zone}: the chest has a [blue]{ZoneRelicRules.OfferChancePercent}%[/blue] chance to also offer a zone relic.
fermentory.bottle_description: Gain [blue]1[/blue] potion slot. Doesn't raise the card removal price.
fermentory.brewing_description: This enemy drinks the potion above it after acting.
fermentory.distil_description: Gain [blue]{FermentoryRules.DistilGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and a potion. A potion slot becomes a [gold]{@fermentory.special_slot}[/gold].
fermentory.distil_no_slot_description: Gain [blue]{FermentoryRules.DistilGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and a potion. Every potion slot is already special.
fermentory.enemy_potion.blood: After acting, it heals [blue]{Amount}[/blue]% of its Max HP.
fermentory.enemy_potion.fire: After acting, it deals [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to {Players}.
fermentory.slot.bottomless_mechanism.des: When you use a potion from this slot, [blue]{FermentoryRules.KeepChancePercent}%[/blue] chance it stays.
fermentory.slot.distribution_system.desc: Potions used from this slot also take effect for every other player.
fermentory.slot.distribution_system.name: Distribution System
fermentory.slot.duplicating_solution.des: Potions used from this slot take effect twice.
fermentory.slot.empowering_draught.descr: When you use a potion from this slot, gain [blue]{FermentoryRules.EmpoweringStrength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
fermentory.slot.empowering_draught.name: Empowering Draught
fermentory.slot.entropic_solvent.descrip: When you use a potion from this slot, [blue]{FermentoryRules.EntropicChancePercent}%[/blue] chance a random potion fills it.

fermentory.slot.quickening_tonic.descrip: When you use a potion from this slot, draw [blue]{FermentoryRules.QuickeningDraw}[/blue] card.

fermentory.slot.volatile_mixture.descrip: When you use a potion from this slot, deal [blue]{FermentoryRules.VolatileDamage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.

fermentory.special_slot_description: A potion slot with a random effect for every potion used from it. It stays special for the rest of the run.
ferrosand.ferroform_description: When its attack breaks your [gold]Block[/gold], it gains [gold]Block[/gold] equal to [blue]{FerrosandRules.FerroformBlockPercent}%[/blue] of the [gold]Block[/gold] it broke.
ferrosand.magnetic_description: When played, pull another random [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold] card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold] (up to [blue]{FerrosandRules.MaxPullsPerTurn}[/blue] per turn).
ferrosand.magnetized_description: Each turn, the first unblocked hit from each player deals only [blue]{FerrosandRules.DampenedDamage}[/blue] damage.
ferrosand.magnetized_smart_description: Its next [blue]{Amount}[/blue] unblocked hits this turn deal only [blue]{FerrosandRules.DampenedDamage}[/blue] damage.
forgotten_empire.forgotten_statue_descri: Takes [blue]{ForgottenEmpireRules.StatueDamageReductionPercent}%[/blue] less damage while it has [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbled}[/gold]. When its [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbled}[/gold] breaks, it gets [blue]{ForgottenEmpireRules.BrokenStatueWeak}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [blue]{ForgottenEmpireRules.BrokenStatueVulnerable}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and loses its [gold]{@forgotten_empire.polishing}[/gold].
forgotten_empire.marbled_description: A second layer of [gold]Block[/gold]: damage hits it after [gold]Block[/gold] and before HP. It doesn't go away at the end of the turn.
forgotten_empire.marbling_description: When played, turn some of your [gold]Block[/gold] into [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbled}[/gold], up to this card's [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbling}[/gold].
forgotten_empire.polishing_description: At the end of its turn, it gains [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbled}[/gold] equal to its [gold]{@forgotten_empire.polishing}[/gold], then its [gold]{@forgotten_empire.polishing}[/gold] goes down by [blue]1[/blue].
frost.biting_cold_description: An enemy with [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold] takes extra damage from each attack equal to its [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold], which goes down by [blue]{FrostRules.ColdSpentPerHit}[/blue] per hit. Playing a card with [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold] gives its [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold] to the enemy it hits, or to a random enemy.
frost.biting_cold_power_description: Takes extra damage from each attack equal to its [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold], which goes down by [blue]{FrostRules.ColdSpentPerHit}[/blue] per hit.
frost.frozen_description: Can't be played. Thaws when the enemies' turn begins.
frost.hoarfrost_description: At the start of your turn, [blue]{FrostRules.FrozenPerTurn}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] become [gold]{@frost.frozen}[/gold].
hallowed.blasphemer_description: Each turn, [blue]{HallowedRules.BlasphemousPerTurn}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] become [gold]{@hallowed.blasphemous}[/gold].
hallowed.hallowed_description: At the end of its turn, if it has at least as much [gold]{@hallowed.hallowed}[/gold] as HP, it dies.
hallowed.hallowed_doom_note: If it also has [gold]Doom[/gold], half its [gold]{@hallowed.hallowed}[/gold] turns into [gold]Doom[/gold] first.
hallowed.hallowing_description: Applies [gold]{@hallowed.hallowed}[/gold] equal to the damage it deals.
hallowed.zealous_description: Its attacks also apply [gold]{@hallowed.hallowed}[/gold] equal to [blue]{HallowedRules.ZealousPercent}%[/blue] of their damage, even when blocked.
halls_of_midas.touch_of_midas_descriptio: Gains [blue]{HallsOfMidasRules.StrengthPerTurn}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] every turn. You gain [blue]{HallsOfMidasRules.GoldPerDamage}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] for each unblocked damage it deals you.
hidden_node.line: {Zone}: one of these may be hiding here: [gold]{@hidden_node.fight}[/gold], [gold]{@hidden_node.rest_site}[/gold], [gold]{@hidden_node.shop}[/gold], [gold]{@hidden_node.unknown}[/gold] or [gold]{@hidden_node.chest}[/gold].
infestation.wriggler_description: Takes attack damage in your place. When it dies, it deals damage equal to its Max HP to ALL enemies, and you lose HP equal to [red]{WrigglingRules.OwnerDeathDamagePercent}%[/red] of its Max HP.

infestation.wriggling_description: When played, summon a [gold]{@infestation.wriggler}[/gold] with HP equal to this card's [gold]{@infestation.wriggling}[/gold]. If you already have one, it gains that much Max HP instead.
mirror.mirrored_description: The first time it drops to half HP, it spawns a [gold]{@mirror.reflection}[/gold] with [blue]{MirrorRules.AloneCloneHpPercent}%[/blue] of its Max HP ([blue]{MirrorRules.GroupCloneHpPercent}%[/blue] with other enemies).
mirror.mirrored_smart_description: The first time it drops to half HP, it spawns a [gold]{@mirror.reflection}[/gold] with [blue]{Amount}%[/blue] of its Max HP.
mirror.reflection_description: A mirrored clone of an enemy. It is stunned on its first turn and can't make clones or summon.

phantasmal.phantasm_haunted_description: Costs [blue]{PhantasmalRules.HauntedCostReduction}[/blue] less. [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. When played, [blue]{PhantasmalRules.HauntedExhaustChancePercent}%[/blue] chance to [gold]Exhaust[/gold].

rest_site.luxurious_rest.no_gold: [red]You don't have {HallsOfMidasRules.LuxuriousRestGoldCost} Gold: it will do nothing.[/red]

rest_site.mirrored_rest.addition: Then duplicate [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
rest_site.troubled_dreams.addition: [blue]{ShadowRules.TroubledDreamsCursePercent}%[/blue] chance to add a random [red]Curse[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Doesn't use up your action.
shadow.light_the_way_description: A card. When played, reveal enemy intents this turn and the [gold]{@shadow.shaded}[/gold] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold], and remove [blue]{ShadowRules.LightTheWayDoomRemoved}[/blue] [gold]Doom[/gold].

shadow.shadow_brutality_description: Its attacks also apply [gold]Doom[/gold] equal to [blue]{ShadowRules.BrutalityDoomPercent}%[/blue] of their damage, even when blocked.
